name: netdata
title: Netdata
description: Real-time performance monitoring with per-second granularity. 2000+ metrics out of the box — CPU, memory, disk, network, Docker containers, and applications. Beautiful auto-generated dashboards.

policy_needs.reason: Netdata reads the metrics of the host and of every process from /proc (read-only)
Netdata reads hardware, disk and cgroup metrics from /sys (read-only)
Netdata's collectors need SYS_ADMIN to read cgroup and network namespace details (Netdata's own install instructions)
Netdata's documented setup turns AppArmor off so its collectors can read what they measure
